lint_missing: {tool} is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
lint_no_file: No {file} was found in the component, so {tool} has nothing to check.
lint_no_files: No file to check was found for {tool} in the workspace ({kind}).
lint_too_many_files: {tool} found more than {limit} files to check, too many to list in a reviewable command. Narrow the workspace with the exclusion list of the configuration.
lint_dotnet_many: The component has several solution or project files ({files}) and no single one to build. Keep one solution file in the component.
lint_exit_error: {tool} ended with code {code} without a result JGates can read: {detail}
lint_timeout: {tool} exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
lint_cancelled: The run was cancelled; {tool} was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
lint_no_invocation: The plan has no lint invocation for the instance {tool}.
lint_condition_read_only: Read-only: the linter reports what it finds and rewrites nothing.
lint_limitation_golangci-lint: golangci-lint run ./... with the project's .golangci.yml (the default linters without one); the modules must be in the dependency volume.
lint_limitation_clippy: cargo clippy compiles the crate offline and reports every compiler and clippy diagnostic; the project's clippy.toml and [lints] tables decide the levels.
lint_limitation_dotnet-analyzers: dotnet build with the .NET analyzers at the recommended level, in the one solution or project of the component; the project's .editorconfig sets the severities.
lint_limitation_shellcheck: ShellCheck over the *.sh, *.bash, *.dash and *.ksh files anywhere in the workspace, and the extensionless files with a shell shebang; the project's .shellcheckrc decides which checks count.
lint_limitation_hadolint: Hadolint over the Dockerfiles and Containerfiles anywhere in the workspace without building any image; the project's .hadolint.yaml decides which rules count.
